migrate.rebuild.heading: Rebuild old payment records
migrate.rebuild.intro_html:
An older version of this site stored less information with each payment. The app cannot refund those payments, because it cannot prove which provider took them.

This page rebuilds the old payment records. It records the provider you choose below with each payment. After that, the app can refund the payment as normal.

The rebuild never contacts the payment provider. It never moves money.
migrate.rebuild.records_waiting: There {count, plural, =0 {are no payment records} =1 {is 1 payment record} other {are # payment records}} to rebuild.
migrate.rebuild.nothing_to_do: Payments this page cannot rebuild still exist. Refund those directly through the payment provider.
migrate.rebuild.provider_hint: The old records do not say which provider took them. Check one payment in your provider dashboard if you are not sure.
migrate.rebuild.confirm_label: Type the provider name to confirm:
migrate.rebuild.error_provider: Choose the provider that took these payments.

migrate.rebuild.flash_progress: Rebuilt {rebuilt, plural, =1 {1 payment record} other {# payment records}}. {remaining, plural, =1 {1 payment record} other {# payment records}} still wait. Press the button again to continue.
